ownership.overlap_rule: Different owners may not claim overlapping paths. Same-owner nested generated policies require allow_overlap on both policies.

categories.description: Shared routing, integration, host boundaries, and final status authority.
A single compiler or runtime module with a stable contract boundary.
A target or backend-specific leaf module and its dedicated fixtures.
A leaf responsible for a reproducible evidence or bootstrap stage.
Package, standard-library, or component build leaf ownership.
A future path reservation; workers may add leaves but may not edit shared paths.

path_policy.reviewed_definition: A reviewed path is human-owned source, contract, routing, or test code. It may be edited only by its owner and requires review before integration.
path_policy.generated_definition: A generated path is reproducible evidence or build output. It is not hand-edited; its generator and owning policy are recorded.
path_policy.reserved_definition: A reserved path is a future leaf namespace. A worker may create a new leaf below it but may not edit another owner or a shared integration surface.
